title: Koala with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='eyeGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='35%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='36%' stop-color='#8fd8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a6fa8'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='18' fill='#9aa7b8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='18' fill='#9aa7b8'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='11' fill='#e8eef5'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='11' fill='#e8eef5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='30' ry='27' fill='#b8c4d4'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#e8eef5'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#6b7a8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='54' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#9aa7b8'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='6' fill='url(#eyeGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='6' fill='url(#eyeGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='36.5' cy='50' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='50' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='54' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='54' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M30 42 l1 3 3 1 -3 1 -1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 3 -1 z' fill='#fff6a8'/>
  <path d='M70 42 l1 3 3 1 -3 1 -1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 3 -1 z' fill='#fff6a8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 66 q6 5 12 0' stroke='#8a97a8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
